You are on the operator’s Windows machine.

## Ask
Alex: On the microSD that shows as **F G H** (same card): **merge all partitions**, and leave **one partition with 19GB** for the Ubuntu regular installer he’s downloading — so drive letters are correct first.

## Target (from prior inspect — RE-VERIFY before wipe)
- Was Disk **3**: Generic STORAGE DEVICE, serial `000000000819`, ~119 GB USB, UniqueId containing `000000000819`
- Partitions were F: BOOT, G: Clean, H: unlabeled

## Do
1. **Re-identify** the physical disk by serial/name/size — do NOT trust Disk# alone (numbers drift). Confirm F/G/H still map to that one disk.
2. **STOP** if:
   - That serial isn’t present
   - F/G/H aren’t on one disk
   - Target looks like C/D/E, the 2TB JMicron (E:), or SanDisk Cruzer Ubuntu stick
3. If confirmed:
   - Backup nothing required (he said merge/ready) — wipe that disk only
   - `diskpart`: select disk by number after serial match → `clean` → `convert gpt` (or mbr if needed for simplicity) → `create partition primary size=19456` (19 GiB ≈ 19456 MB) → `format fs=fat32 quick label=UBUNTU` (FAT32 OK for ≤19GB installer staging; NTFS also OK if FAT32 fails) → `assign letter=F`
   - Leave **remainder unallocated** (no second partition) so only **one letter** appears
4. Verify: only one volume on that disk, ~19GB, letter F (or report actual letter), rest free space.
5. Short note update under `D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes\` about the microSD layout.

Do **not** flash an ISO yet (he’s still downloading). Do **not** touch other disks.

Return: before/after layout, disk serial, letter, free space remaining.
</user_query>

list disk

clean
convert gpt

format fs=fat32 quick label=UBUNTU
assign letter=F
list partition

detail disk

$scriptPath = "$env:TEMP\diskpart-microsd-ubuntu.txt"
Set-Content -Path $scriptPath -Value $script -Encoding ASCII

content.text: diskpart needs elevation; partitions look cleared but incomplete. Retrying with elevated PowerShell.

input.command:
# Re-confirm target, then elevate diskpart
$d = Get-Disk | Where-Object { $_.SerialNumber.Trim() -eq '000000000819' -and $_.FriendlyName -match 'Generic STORAGE DEVICE' }
if (-not $d) { throw 'TARGET SERIAL NOT FOUND - ABORT' }
Write-Host "TARGET: Disk $($d.Number) $($d.FriendlyName) Serial=$($d.SerialNumber) Size=$($d.Size) Style=$($d.PartitionStyle)"
$diskNum = $d.Number

$script = @"
select disk $diskNum
detail disk
clean
convert gpt
create partition primary size=19456
format fs=fat32 quick label=UBUNTU
assign letter=F
list partition
list volume
detail disk
exit
"@
$scriptPath = "$env:TEMP\diskpart-microsd-ubuntu.txt"
Set-Content -Path $scriptPath -Value $script -Encoding ASCII
$logPath = "$env:TEMP\diskpart-microsd-ubuntu.log"

# Elevate diskpart via Start-Process RunAs
$psi = New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo
$psi.FileName = 'diskpart.exe'
$psi.Arguments = "/s `"$scriptPath`""
$psi.Verb = 'runas'
$psi.UseShellExecute = $true
$psi.WindowStyle = 'Hidden'
# Redirect doesn't work with UseShellExecute+runas easily; wrap via cmd
$wrapper = @"
diskpart /s `"$scriptPath`" > `"$logPath`" 2>&1
"@
$wrapPath = "$env:TEMP\diskpart-microsd-run.cmd"
Set-Content -Path $wrapPath -Value $wrapper -Encoding ASCII

$p = Start-Process -FilePath 'cmd.exe' -ArgumentList "/c `"$wrapPath`"" -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru
Write-Host "Elevated process exit: $($p.ExitCode)"
if (Test-Path $logPath) {
  Write-Host '--- DISKPART LOG ---'
  Get-Content $logPath
} else {
  Write-Host 'No log file created'
}
input.description: Elevated diskpart wipe and create partition

input.command:
$d = Get-Disk | Where-Object { $_.SerialNumber.Trim() -eq '000000000819' }
Write-Host '=== AFTER ==='
$d | Select-Object Number, FriendlyName, SerialNumber, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}}, PartitionStyle, UniqueId | Format-List
$parts = Get-Partition -DiskNumber $d.Number
$parts | Select-Object PartitionNumber, DriveLetter, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}}, Type, @{N='OffsetMB';E={[math]::Round($_.Offset/1MB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize
$vol = Get-Volume -DriveLetter F -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$vol | Select-Object DriveLetter, FileSystemLabel, FileSystem, @{N='SizeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.Size/1GB,2)}}, @{N='FreeGB';E={[math]::Round($_.SizeRemaining/1GB,2)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize
$used = ($parts | Measure-Object -Property Size -Sum).Sum
$unalloc = $d.Size - $used
Write-Host ("Unallocated remaining: {0:N2} GB ({1} bytes)" -f ($unalloc/1GB), $unalloc)
Write-Host ("Partition count on disk: {0}" -f @($parts).Count)
Write-Host ("G present: {0}  H present: {0}" -f [bool](Get-Volume -DriveLetter G -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue), [bool](Get-Volume -DriveLetter H -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))
# G/H check separately
Write-Host ("G: " + [bool](Get-Volume -DriveLetter G -EA SilentlyContinue))
Write-Host ("H: " + [bool](Get-Volume -DriveLetter H -EA SilentlyContinue))

$notesDir = 'D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Server Handoffs\Ava Ivy\notes'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $notesDir | Out-Null
$notePath = Join-Path $notesDir 'microsd-ubuntu-staging-layout.md'
@"
# microSD layout — Ubuntu installer staging

**Date:** 2026-08-03 (operator local ~2026-08-02 evening HST)  
**Disk:** Generic STORAGE DEVICE, serial ``000000000819``, UniqueId contains ``000000000819``, ~119 GB USB (Disk # may drift)

## Before
- Three partitions / letters: **F:** BOOT (FAT32 ~1 GB), **G:** Clean (NTFS ~40 GB), **H:** unlabeled (FAT32 ~78 GB)
- All on one physical card (same serial)

## After (merge + stage partition)
- ``clean`` → GPT → one primary partition **size=19456 MB (~19 GiB)**
- Format: **FAT32** label **UBUNTU**, letter **F:**
- Remainder **unallocated** (~100 GB) — no second partition / no extra drive letter
- Do **not** flash ISO until Alex finishes download

## Touch rule
Only this serial. Never C/D/E, JMicron 2TB (E:), or SanDisk Cruzer Ubuntu stick.
"@ | Set-Content -Path $notePath -Encoding UTF8
Write-Host "Note written: $notePath"
Get-Content $notePath
